title: RAW UNREVIEWED: inscription instructions distinguish consumed carriers from a repeatedly cleared support
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Historical healing instructions treat written content as something physically applied and transferred. A whole account must distinguish the persistent support, successive inscriptions and ingested material. Repeated operation frames alone cannot identify these roles; obligatory fresh-object versus same-object dependencies can constrain joint latent readings. No Voynich form receives a meaning.

design.production_mechanism: A compiler copies executable writing instructions together with their literal payloads. Some text therefore specifies what to write, rather than directly naming an ingredient or asserting the proposition written. An entire passage may alternate instruction grammar, quoted payload and subsequent physical treatment of that payload. This is a proposed historical content architecture, not a claim that Voynich is a charm book.

actual_source.citation: Lea T. Olsan, Writing on the Hand in Ink, Incantatio 7 (2018), publisher online 2020; printed pp.21,32-33,44-45.
actual_source.owned_passages: Royal MS12 B XXV f61v, printed note93; Cambridge University Library Additional9308 f53r, complete Appendix9; Dd4.44 f29r, complete Appendix7.
actual_source.source_fact: Appendix9 prescribes three wafers with different inscriptions on successive days, each eaten; prayers follow each consumption. Appendix7 explicitly takes another leaf on later days, changes the inscription, and resumes earlier prayers. Royal12 B XXV uses the same palm, dissolves its writing in water, and repeats drinking with later inscriptions. Its following Peter narrative and amulet remain separate connected content; no whole-folio claim is made.
actual_source.limits: These are published transcriptions and translations, not a new native collation. Royal's possible omitted crosses and reduced later-day instructions remain uncertain. Efficacy is a source assertion. Do not infer a universal exact payload shared by all witnesses.

positive_structural_inputs: GDT608/282/286/318: ordered internal composition and whole-form/context effects must both survive; a single detachable suffix is not assumed.
GDT915/916: known r/l families transfer, new stem-pair grammar does not; any role contrast is evaluated with complete known forms and cannot export an invented productive ending.

Existing complete admitted paragraph packets permit joint hypothetical accounts with unknown grammar and referents; no confirmed lexical anchor is logically required. No packet has been searched or nominated by this producer.

finite_contrast.CONSUMED_SUPPORT: Each cycle consumes its current carrier. A later writing event requires a different extant carrier, whether introduced explicitly earlier or by a written selection from an initial set. Reusing the consumed object is contradictory.
finite_contrast.CLEARED_SUPPORT: Clearing removes an inscription while retaining its support. Later writing may resume that same support, but must produce a fresh inscription. Consuming the support confuses two typed arguments.
finite_contrast.CONTENT_ONLY_DESCRIPTION: Payload propositions merely describe things; no written-content object is produced for a later physical operation. A passage that explicitly treats that produced inscription cannot be completed by this account without a separate construction.

design.joint_binding_consequence: One shared grammar must connect all introductions, reprises and consuming/clearing operations across the complete passage. Candidate literal-payload spans are values of a writing construction, not arbitrary aliases for its materials. Global renaming may preserve domain names, but cannot turn an already consumed individual into an available one while preserving event incidence. Retain this residual lexical ambiguity even if one lifecycle survives.
design.observable_falsifier: For any proposed complete reading, freeze the written producer and later consumer spans and the same-versus-new referent grammar jointly. A consumed-support interpretation fails if its later written reprise requires the destroyed individual and supplies no fresh-object selection; a cleared-support interpretation fails if the fixed grammar transfers the support itself into the consumed material. A model that erases these dependencies or assigns each repetition a fresh object by fiat is not a discriminating reading. Absence of an overt repeated noun alone is not failure: licensed ellipsis and initial-set selection must be accounted for.
design.smallest_next_step: For one already available whole-reading candidate, author the three rival referent-lifecycle accounts using the same complete native unit and one shared construction inventory, including every unknown. Record whether any actually written reprise or selection forces different availability at a later operation. Do not build a search engine first. If all variants merely rename latent states or need freely invented consumers, keep this card raw rather than declaring a fit. Exact-form profiles and prior counterexamples are mandatory before assigning any concrete Voynich meaning.
novelty_and_predecessors: GDT1023 models picture/material distinction and one final physical enclosure; its 71 assumed meanings, later transfer gaps and no semantic confirmation remain. This card concerns recurrent inscription production plus selective destruction of inscription versus carrier, not another enclosure intervention.

IDEA895 distinguishes reusing an earlier process result from applying a recipe pattern anew. Both alternatives here may apply the same pattern anew; they differ in obligatory lifetime and identity of the support across every application.
IDEA38 inherits carriers by parser policy. This card forbids counting that inherited annotation as an observed endpoint; actual complete written consumers must distinguish lifecycle accounts.
GDT917's fixed literal diminishing-charm chain remains refuted. No diminishing string, constant seven-record refrain, prayer vocabulary or numerical interpretation is inherited.
GDT1138 retained quoted descriptions without later meaningful consumers. Merely storing quoted strings is likewise insufficient here.
